Fatalities in Unit █02  
Four fatalities in Unit █02, two victims (D54 and D56) originated from Unit █04.

On █ floor, Units █04 and █05 were destroyed. In Unit █04, the kitchen was fully burned out and no remains of the kitchen door were found, indicating that it was either removed prior to the incident or completely consumed by fire. Units █06, █07 and █08 were also seriously damaged.

Unit █01 was totally consumed; the entrance door is immediately adjacent to the entrance door of Unit █02, and was burnt through.

Hot smoke penetrated into Unit █02 through the door gaps while other units on the same floor were burning for an extended period.

The post-fire photograph of the Unit █02 entrance door shows significant charring on the upper portion of the leaf and heavy soot deposition on the ceiling of the entrance foyer inside of Unit █02.
